verdict.rationale: Poly is a file storage and second-brain product with a Mind notes area, so an interactive knowledge graph is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence documents folder view modes (Icon, Grid, Feed, Detail, Tree), search and memories, but nothing about a graph of notes and connections or filtering such a graph. A Tree view of folders is an adjacent feature, not a link graph.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can explore my knowledge base as an interactive graph of notes and connections, filtered to what I care about
